means: One constructed replay per King Crimson build board the planner can build: from an empty board, the page's grey stack built out of pieces WE chose, then the page's own pieces, then the stood T into the TST slot the corpus window reads, then the STSD under it. Run through the vendored Triangle engine. A board no demo stands on is published unbuilt with its reason.
not_eligible_because: constructed, not played: the queue, the hold and the key inputs are ours, and the stack's pieces are ours too (the page draws it grey). No claim id, no badge, no figure in any count.
caveat: the page draws its stacks grey; a demo stands only on what the planner can build from an empty board without clearing a line, in two bags; every board carrying this shape holds a 52-cell stack, more than two bags hold, and three of them draw it in a light grey the planner reads as a page piece.
rules: a demo starts from an empty board, as every decoder does; the terrain is an exact cover of its grey cells by pieces the planner chose, every one reachable from spawn by the engine's own moves, no line cleared
the page's own pieces are the build board's lower-case letters, one whole piece per letter
the stood T is the one T placement at which the corpus window (technique-facts.ts windowMatch, as drawn) matches the build board, and must be credited a full T-spin clearing the variant's lines
the engine is the arbiter: every lock must land where the plan put it, with its spin, lines and hold flag

board.coords: y-UP: row 0 is the bottom row
